# anzi

<!-- Kept < 200 lines. Stable rules only. Evolving state lives in status.md. Generated by jarvis 0.5.0 on 2026-10-11. -->

## What this is
Anzi: a Next.js web app (map of addresses, address add/request flows, mailing list). Kind: poc. The git root is `Anzi/`; the app lives in `NextJS/` (started from the Cruip "Open" landing-page template).

## Commands
Source of truth: `.claude/jarvis.json` → `commands`. Use them, do not guess. Run from the repo root; they `cd NextJS` themselves.
- lint: `cd NextJS && npm run lint`
- typecheck: `cd NextJS && npx tsc --noEmit`
- build: `cd NextJS && npm run build`
- format / test: none configured. Dev server: `npm run dev` in `NextJS/` (needs `.env.local`).
- Install: `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps` in `NextJS/` (plain `npm ci` fails on a mapbox-gl peer conflict).

## Working agreement
- Read `status.md` first; do not re-read the whole repo. Update it at the end of any significant change (what changed, why, next steps, known issues).
- Prefer small, verifiable steps. After a change run the `verify` skill before saying "done".
- Explore with targeted searches; delegate broad/noisy exploration to a subagent (`Explore`, cheap model).
- Never invent APIs, flags or files: check the code/docs first.
- Ask before: adding a dependency, changing a public interface, deleting data, touching infra/CI.
- Do not edit secrets or lockfiles by hand (hooks block it).
- No unrequested refactors or reformatting of untouched code.

## Architecture (stable parts only)
- `NextJS/app/` is the Next 13 app router. Route groups: `(auth)`, `(default)` (landing), `(pages)` (map, add_address, request_address).
- API routes live in `NextJS/app/(pages)/api/<name>/` as `route.ts` (HTTP verbs, calls `connectToDatabase()`) plus `<name>_controller.js` (logic, returns `NextResponse`). Keep this route/controller split.
- Data: Mongoose models in `NextJS/models/`, connection in `NextJS/utils/connectMongo.js`. `NextJS/server.mjs` is the custom dev server.
- UI: `NextJS/components/` (Tailwind); map is Mapbox GL (`components/map.tsx`).

## Conventions
- Both `package-lock.json` and `yarn.lock` are tracked; npm is the effective manager (dependabot updates `package-lock.json`). Do not run `yarn` or regenerate lockfiles. npm also rewrites `yarn.lock`: `git checkout -- NextJS/yarn.lock` after any npm install.
- Env vars (`NEXT_PUBLIC_MONGODB_URI`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN`) belong in `NextJS/.env.local` only, never committed.

## Gotchas
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` vars are inlined into the client bundle; the DB URI currently uses that prefix (see status.md).
- Strict TypeScript, but the controllers/models are plain `.js` with `allowJs`, so they are barely type-checked.
